title: Anchored delta watchdog with explainable rollback playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Staged model promotions (canary / A/B / shadow) occasionally surface subtle quality regressions that standard aggregate scorecards miss. These regressions can be high-cost (customer-visible hallucinations, compliance violations) but low-signal in raw token-level metrics. We need an automated watchdog that ties regression signals to explainable changes in golden prompt sets, attributes impact to cohorts, and produces deterministic rollback recommendations plus a human-friendly playbook for adjudication.

Objective: Implement an Anchored Delta Watchdog (ADW) that: anchors scoring to stable golden prompt fingerprints, computes contextual delta signals (per-prompt, per-cohort, temporal smoothing), runs probabilistic quarantine logic to avoid flapping, and outputs an explainable rollback decision record for downstream automation (auto-rollback when safe) or human review.
proposal: Create an anchored reference layer: maintain a versioned golden set with per-prompt metadata (intent, cohort tags, expected score ranges, priority weight)
Compute delta signals: for each candidate rollout window compute anchored_delta = new_score - anchor_score with a confidence band using bootstrap over recent samples
Contextual aggregation: aggregate deltas by cohort and intent using a weighted robust mean (Huber-style) and compute z-scores relative to historical variance
Tiered hysteresis/quarantine: adopt a three-tier trigger model: WARN -> QUARANTINE (stop traffic to candidate for cohort) -> AUTO-ROLLBACK (if sustained and high-confidence and low collateral risk)

Explainable evidence bundle: on any trigger produce a decision bundle containing top-n prompts driving the delta, per-prompt diffs, cohort impact table, and the sequence-level examples with model outputs for side-by-side inspection

Integrate with rollout controller: surface ADW decisions to the rollout conductor API (canary manager) as proposal objects; conductor may accept auto-rollback per policy or escalate to human-in-loop route
UI/Observability: add an ADW tab in Console per-rollout with timeline, per-prompt explainability, and recommended action with rationale
Failure and noise handling: build temporal smoothing (EWMA over windows), false-positive suppression (probabilistic thresholding using historical FPR), and a replay mode for offline audit
design:
High-level architecture: a lightweight streaming evaluator runs alongside shadow/canary traffic. The evaluator attaches a golden-prompt fingerprint to each request (if matched) and emits a compact event to the ADW service. ADW ingests events into a short-term rolling store, computes anchored deltas per configured window (default: 1h, 6h, 24h) and runs cohort-aware aggregation. The decision engine applies the tiered hysteresis policy, produces explainable bundles, and emits a decision event to the conductor API.

Data schema (summary): golden_prompt_id, cohort_tags (list), anchor_model_version, anchor_score, observed_score, timestamp, request_id, customer_id (hashed), rollout_id. All fields are telemetry primitives. No PII stored.

Policy knobs (defaults): warn_threshold = 2.0 z, quarantine_threshold = 3.0 z, rollback_threshold = 4.0 z OR absolute drop >= 5% on weighted scorecard for >3 consecutive windows. Cohort minimum sample = 50 prompts/window. These knobs live in rollout policy config and are overrideable per-customer for Dedicated/Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: ADW ingests golden-anchored events for canary and shadow traffic with <100ms added latency to request path (mostly asynchronous) and overall system P95 < 200ms for decision bundle generation
ADW computes per-prompt and per-cohort anchored deltas and exposes per-window z-scores via API
Console shows an ADW timeline for a sample canary (test rollout) with explainability view showing top 25 prompts and side-by-side outputs

Trigger policy correctly transitions through WARN->QUARANTINE->ROLLBACK in a simulated dataset (see test plan); auto-rollback only happens if policy conditions met and rollback safety checks pass (no open migrations, infra healthy)
Human adjudication flow: on WARN/QUARANTINE a human reviewer can accept, ignore, or escalate to rollback; actions are recorded in audit logs and linked to PRs/incident tickets
Unit/integration tests and a replay harness exist to reproduce any decision bundle deterministically from stored events
monitoring_playbook: Primary signals: anchored_delta_mean, anchored_delta_z, prompt_coverage_pct, cohort_sample_count, decision_rate (WARN/QUARANTINE/ROLLBACK), false_positive_rate_estimate. Runbook steps: 1) On repeated WARNs without quarantine: check golden set staleness and sampling bias; 2) On unexpected QUARANTINE: inspect top-n prompts in explainability bundle and re-run replay with replay-harness; 3) On AUTO-ROLLBACK: validate rollback safety checklist (infra/capacity/feature flags) then review decision bundle; if rollback is safe, the conductor will initiate rollback and notify SRE and PM; 4) If noisy alerts spike, reduce sensitivity, increase cohort min-sample, and schedule evaluation of golden set coverage. All actions must create a post-mortem entry linked to rollout_id.
telemetry_events: eval.delta_aggregate (rollout_id, window, cohort, mean_delta, z_score, sample_count)
dashboard_requirements: Console: ADW tab under each rollout with (1) timeline of anchored_delta_z by cohort, (2) prompt coverage heatmap, (3) explainability table with top contributing prompts and delta snippets, (4) recommended action card with confidence and rationale, (5) ability to create a replay job from a window and link to PR/issue. Add a global ADW dashboard for alerts and recent automatic rollbacks across accounts. Export capability for evidence bundles (zip of examples + metadata).
test_plan: Unit tests for delta computation and robust aggregation
Synthetic replay tests: inject known regressions (semantic and generation-quality) into candidate model and assert ADW triggers expected decisions
A/B canary simulation: run full pipeline in staging with traffic split and validate UI + automation paths
Chaos checks: simulate missing anchor scores, partial coverage, and low-sample cohorts to ensure no unsafe auto-rollbacks
Performance test: ensure ADW scales to 10k eval events/sec with 99th pct decision latency < 500ms (async path)
risks_mitigations: Risk: False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: tiered hysteresis, probabilistic thresholding, and mandatory safety checks before auto-rollback.
Risk: Golden set drift (anchors become stale). Mitigation: automated golden set freshness job, monthly curator review, and per-rollout anchor_version pinning.
Risk: Coverage gaps for long-tail customers. Mitigation: per-customer enrichment pipelines to expand golden prompts and cohort tagging for dedicated/private customers.
Risk: Explainability bundle leaks sensitive prompts. Mitigation: hash/strip PII, review data retention policy, and restrict bundle download to authorized users only.
